description_expanded: Overview550ft to Public Beach, 4 BR w/ Private Pool/Heat Option - Walk to SeasideThe Space Homecoming CottageHOME HIGHLIGHTS: Private Heated Pool (Heat Option Available)– Relax in your own backyard oasis (Heat option available) 550ft. to the Beach! – Quick & easy walk to the sugar-white sands 4 Free Bikes – Explore Seaside & 30A like a local Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected Outdoor Shower – Rinse off after a day in the sun Gas Grill & Fire Pit – Perfect for BBQ nights & cozy evenings Driveway Parking for 2 Cars – Convenient & hassle-free Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacationingWelcome to Homecoming CottageWhen arriving at Homecoming Cottage, leave your car and enjoy a short walk or bike ride to the beautiful beaches or to all the boutiques, restaurants and events in and around Seaside. Enjoy the sunset drinks at Bud’ N Alleys, lunch time specials at Seagrove Market or elegant fine dining at Surfing Deer restaurant just minutes away!Homecoming Cottage has been recently renovated and is a 2 story, 4 bedroom, 2 bath home with an enclosed front porch, outdoor patio, grilling area and a private heated pool. Recent renovations at Homecoming Cottage include updated kitchen, outdoor shower, and an added grilling deck. The home features all hardwood floors, granite countertops, and is well appointed throughout. Homecoming Cottage has ample parking, bike rack, and fire pit, along with stackable washer/dryer unit, complimentary Wi-Fi and cable.The family area includes a 50” LED TV-DVD, working fireplace, a comfortable settee, side chairs, coffee table, several end tables with lamps. An open kitchen and dining combo adjoins an airy living area.The kitchen has been recently renovated with stainless steel appliances and includes a cooker range, microwave oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, and wine cooler. At the end of the kitchen is the dining area which contains a custom-made 7’ wooden dining table, benches and chairs.Behind the kitchen is a king bedroom which leads to an additional bedroom featuring two built-in twins overlooking the private pool. The king bedroom has a 39” LED TV and a walk-in closet. There is a private bathroom for this area with a tub/shower and sink.The second floor contains 2 more bedrooms--one featuring a king-sized bed, dresser, 39" LED TV and a walk-in closet and the second bedroom which is ideal for children and offers a pair of twin beds, dresser, built-in closet space, and a wall-mounted 39” LED TV-DVD player. Both have access to a bathroom with a full walk-in shower and double vanity sink.A 10’ x 18’ pool is just steps outside the back door (equipped with a pool safety alarm) in the private fenced back yard. Pool heat option available. The back yard features an overlook deck with a grilling/barbecue area, an outdoor shower area, an outdoor seating area with chaise lounges and table seating for four on the brick paved pool deck.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat*Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteedSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom: King sized bed2nd Floor Bedroom: King sized bedFirst Floor Bedroom: Two twin sized beds2nd Floor Bedroom: Two twin sized bedsAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
